missed.point: A headset is worn on the head and blocks the wearer's vision, so that the wearer experiences a virtual world through it; a user wearing a headset is the most common perception of virtual reality. Held only inside 1/S0/F1, which should fail.
A small share can still be a large amount of money: military budgets are huge, so the 4 percent military share translates to a huge sum.

Extended reality intuitively means extending reality by some means; as a system, it means using systems to augment our reality or to replace our perception of reality. The recap adds this way of putting the definition, which no earlier fact holds.

A caution: non-immersive virtual reality is also experienced on a regular screen and is still called immersive from a psychological point of view, but that does not apply to a computer-aided design system.
A three-dimensional movie is partly (semi-) immersive because it blocks the visual sense and partly the auditory sense. 4/S2/F3 says 'partly immersive' without the reason.
